deviations: Images are tagged birka-ci-local-ops / birka-ci-local-api (not birka-ops / birka-api) and built from the local build cache only: every base image pinned to the digest in the cache (no pull, no tag lookup), and a dead HTTP(S) proxy for every RUN, so any download fails (`--network=none` changes BuildKit's cache key). The ops image's package layer was fetched once, by the owner's decision (2026-10-08), with network: docker build --progress=plain --build-context python:3.12.14-slim=<the runner's cached pin> --target ops -t birka-ci-local-ops backend   (from the repository, network allowed); log in /Users/nikitahlushak/.cache/birka-runtime/ci/runs/2026-10-08-ops-image-fetch.txt. A build that fails here fails the job; only before that one fetch is a blocked download of the ops image "incomplete" (still exit 1).
`--network host` with localhost:5432 becomes the user network birka-ci-local with birka-ci-local-pg:5432 (Docker Desktop on macOS has no host networking unless it is switched on in its settings).
PostgreSQL 17: postgres:17-alpine (same env, initdb args, health check), container birka-ci-local-pg, published on 127.0.0.1:55417.
The watcher container is birka-ci-local-watch (not `watch`); backups/ and keys/ live in the runner's work directory, not in the repository; the drill report is copied to the evidence directory.
